issues.title: waiting_jobs / queue-depth gauges stick after idle

snippets.design:
# Design P1-1 v1 (user-locked)
## Goal
Idle scrape shows mortred_waiting_jobs=0 and mortred_queue_depth=0; gauges match atomic _m_waiting_jobs.
## Boonds
No packing/Docker. Admission still reads the atomic.
## Root cause
_m_waiting_jobs decremented in SeriesWork callback; set_waiting_jobs/set_queue_depth only on reply path (before decrement) then never again.
## Fix
1. PrometheusMetrics::bind_waiting_depth(const std::atomic<size_t>*) so render() loads live value (derive-at-scrape).
2. BaseAiServerImpl binds &_m_waiting_jobs after init.
3. publish_waiting_gauges() after admit += and series callback -= (and keep reply path).
4. Unit test: bind+idle zero; update e2e comment if needed.

issues.title: Default check / CI TSan structurally fragile

snippets.design:
# Design P1-2 v1 (user-locked)
## Goal
check and CI TSan structurally green.
## Bounds
No packing/Docker; do not widen sanitizer label set.
## Root cause
1. packed_batch_nvi_unittest / cv_image_input_unittest subclass BackendCvModel needing GpuDecodeSlot but must not link libmodels (own InferenceSession::create).
2. TSan builds 6 targets; ctest -L sanitizer also selects unbuilt rate_limit_gcra_unittest.
## Fix
1. EXTRA_SRCS gpu_jpeg_decoder.cpp for those two unittests.
2. Add rate_limit_gcra_unittest to CI TSan --target list.

# Design P1-3 v1 (user-locked)
## Goal
enlightengan.inl compiles named_tensor_as; contract UT stays green.
## Bounds
Include only; no inference logic change.
## Fix
Add #include "models/backend/model_runtime.h" to enlightengan.inl.
